newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil workers may strike next week.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil workers may strike next week.

text.p: Venezuelan oil workers' union Fedepetrol has threatened to strike in Zulia state next week on concerns that oil operations, and with them workers' benefits, are increasingly being transferred to private companies, union sources said.
Zulia state is the most important oil-producing region in Venezuela.
"Fedepetrol presented a strike petition to the Labour Ministry's representative in Zulia on Wednesday," a legal advisor at Venezuela's umbrella union group, the CTV, told Reuters.

The strike can take place 120 hours after the petition is filed. PdVSA is yet to officially reply to Fedepetrol's demands. But the Labour Ministry has called for a meeting between State- owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) and union officials early next week.

The possibility that private companies contracted by PdVSA may renege on workers' collective contracts "could give rise to a true conflict in which you'll see Zulia's oil companies get involved," Fedepetrol President Carlos Ortega told Zulia newspaper El Regional Wednesday.
